description: Request a full backfill of a stock whose reports look missing or broken, and return its current status. Idempotent — if the stock was already submitted recently (within the last 127 feedback records), it returns that existing status instead of queueing a duplicate; otherwise it queues a re-fetch from the IPO prospectus onward and returns status 'pending' plus the new id (poll get_feedback_status). Free keys: once per 3 seconds, 31 stocks per 7 days per key. Yearly keys: 3 per second, 8,191 stocks per 7 days per key.
name: submit_feedback
